mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CONCAT('ledger-', t.id) AS order_key, 'ledger' AS platform_code, 'app_tip' AS channel_code, t.id AS order_id, t.user_id, t.amount, t.status, t.pay_channel, t.reason AS remark, t.target AS target_type, COALESCE(t.paid_time, t.create_time) AS pay_time FROM ledger_tip_order t UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('portal-', o.id), 'portal', CASE WHEN o.target_type = 'article_paid' THEN 'paid_reading' ELSE 'portal_tip' END, o.id, o.user_id, o.amount, o.status, o.pay_channel, o.message, o.target_type, COALESCE(o.paid_time, o.created_time) FROM portal_tip_order o UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('vip-', p.id), p.platform_code, 'vip', p.id, p.user_id, p.amount, CASE WHEN p.status IN ('PAID', 'SETTLED') THEN 'paid' WHEN p.status = 'CLOSED' THEN 'closed' ELSE 'pending' END, p.channel, p.subject, SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.biz_no, ':', 2), COALESCE(p.pay_success_time, p.create_time) FROM pay_order p WHERE p.biz_type = 'vip' ) u WHERE 1=1 AND u.platform_code = #{platformCode} AND u.status = #{status} AND u.channel_code = #{channelCode} AND u.pay_time >= #{startTime} AND u.pay_time <= #{endTime} ORDER BY u.pay_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
